Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. When a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves its current area while activation is pending, the effect can no longer be activated.
Card Q&A.q: When I used this card’s  effect to delete 1 of my Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect and play [Kimeramon] or [Millenniummon] from the trash, I declared an Assembly for the card to be played. If I place the deleted card for the Assembly at such times, can I activate that card’s [On Deletion] effect?
When this card's  effect would play a Digimon, can I declare a DigiXros or Assembly for that card and further reduce its play cost?

Effect: While you have a Digimon or Tamer with the [DM] trait on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] ＜Draw 2＞ and trash 2 cards in your hand. Then, place this card in the battle area.
・By deleting 1 of your play cost 7 or lower Digimon, you may play 1 Digimon card with [Kimeramon] or [Millenniummon] in its name from your trash with the play cost reduced by 3.
Security Effect: [Security] ＜Draw 2＞ and trash 2 cards in your hand. Then, place this card in the battle area.
